Good news: **no, the pot replacement won't count against your Plant Care Guarantee.** Replacements for damaged-on-arrival items are separate from the guarantee's one free replacement. So you'd still have that in reserve if the plant declines later.

- **Cracked pot (DOA):** report it within **48 hours of delivery**, and we send a free replacement or a refund.
- **Plant Care Guarantee:** this stays fully available for **30 days from delivery** (90 days for Leafy Plus members).

I don't have details on whether a DOA replacement plant gets its own fresh guarantee window or follows the original delivery date, so I don't want to guess. If that matters to you, mention it in your email to help@leafy.example (answered within **1 business day**) and the team can confirm.

Thanks for checking, and I hope your rubber plant settles in happily! Reach out any time. 🌿
